experiment: Frozen shared constitutive-law transfer into official-source PIDG

models.name: PIDG plus our frozen material prior
PIDG plus our frozen material prior

flow: Dual TV-L1 between retained training neighbors, 320x180
depth: released monocular per-image estimates, train frames only
validation_selection: highest mean foreground PSNR between the two material-prior strengths; fixed final checkpoints
shared_compatibility_changes: restore official missing material-field module from matching historical source
use one frame-index clock across train/validation/test
supply missing default renderer flow flag at evaluation
handle scalar validation PSNR as float
use eager CUDA image loading; optional on-the-fly loader has undefined attribute
ours_module: ScaleSeparatedMaterialLaw: previously learned frozen objective isotropic energy; finite-difference deformation Jacobian; normalized energy plus explicit inversion penalty
physics_interpretation: Jacobian values are geometry sanity diagnostics, not accuracy against unknown material/force ground truth.
figure_policy: Matched GT/baseline/hybrid frames and crops at identical display settings; favorable examples explicitly selected after evaluation; all-frame metrics and least favorable example retained.
